subject: Housing Stability Notification Ordinance Implementation
overview: The committee met to receive an update from the Office of Planning, Development and Sustainability on the rollout of the Housing Stability Notification Ordinance. The committee voted to keep the matter in committee to coordinate further implementation details with the Building Department.

items.title: Discussion on Housing Stability Notification Ordinance Implementation (Paper 24-042)
items.summary: Planning staff reported that the Tenants' Rights and Resources Guide is nearly finalized in multiple languages, with plans to notify all residential property owners by mail directing them to the online document, while committee members explored coordinating outreach through tax bills and working with the Building Department. The committee voted to keep the paper in committee to reconvene for future updates.
